text: Your 2:37am screenshot was NOT a stall: it was scanning normally (8,903 of 10,784 prices at 16 a second, one scan takes ~11 min). What was wrong: right after I restarted the engine, its old status stayed on screen frozen for a minute or two with a green 'Scanning' dot, and a fresh scan showed 'Bets listed 0 / Odds age n/a' instead of the last list. Both are the stale-display bugs in TCL79. For REAL stalls: new version now has the engine publish when its progress last moved, and the 5-minute GitHub watchdog restarts a run whose scan hasn't moved for 10 minutes (and one whose Novig address is refused for 5), with no input from you. It's in the build going out now.
